001.cast: A young East Asian woman with a short straight black bob and turquoise apron in a school pottery studio; her instructor has silver hair, a neat bun and a tan apron.
panels: At a pottery wheel the bob-haired student proudly starts shaping a tall cylinder of soft brown clay.
The clay cylinder slumps sideways into a shapeless heap. She looks disappointed, hands hovering on either side.
The silver-haired instructor demonstrates holding both hands low around a fresh lump on the wheel; the student watches closely.
The young woman proudly lifts her successful, evenly shaped wide clay bowl off the wheel as the instructor smiles.
001.essay: 学校每周该不该留出一节课，让学生自己决定学什么？

002.cast: A slim young man with short black curls, round glasses, a rust-orange backpack and a distinctive long dark violin case; a taller girl in a jade cardigan is a returning student.
panels: The new student holding his closed violin case looks puzzled at several identical doors branching off a school corridor.
He stops the girl in the jade cardigan to ask for help, pointing to his violin case. She understands and points down the corridor.
The girl walks with him, opening a door onto a music room full of students and music stands; his shoulders relax.
The newcomer is seated playing his violin alongside the ensemble, and gives a warm grateful smile to the girl waving from the open door.
002.essay: 新生刚入学时，学校该不该安排高年级同学带他们熟悉校园？

003.cast: Campus photography club outdoors; photographer is a young East Asian woman with braided hair, mustard overalls and a black camera. The same three classmates wear violet, blue and rust.
panels: The photographer lines up her three classmates in a campus courtyard under bright sunlight for a group photo.
From next to the camera see the three in glaring direct sun all squinting, shielding their eyes with their hands. The photographer lowers the camera.
The photographer beckons the same three into the cool even shade of the leafy courtyard tree, where they relax side by side.
Close view of the camera's rear screen in her hand showing the same three smiling open-eyed faces under leaves; they lean in delighted to see it. No interface characters.
003.essay: 去博物馆上课时，学生应该自由选择想看的展品，还是跟着老师一起参观？

004.cast: Two teenage school science-club partners at a wooden table: one wears two brown braids and a plum sweater, the other has a blond buzz cut and denim shirt. A gap between two thick books, blank sheets of paper and plain metal washers.
panels: The two partners lay one ordinary flat sheet of paper across the gap between the two supports and balance a single metal washer at its center.
The sheet sags deep into the gap, dropping the washer onto the table between the books. The partners peer at the failed bridge.
Their hands fold a fresh sheet of paper back and forth into wide accordion pleats; show the zigzag end in close-up.
The firm pleated paper bridge now spans the SAME two supports with a stack of several metal washers at its center. Both partners marvel at their successful test.
004.essay: 给学生的实验打分时，老师应该更看重最后的结果，还是学生解决问题的过程？

005.cast: A shy teenage girl in large round glasses and a sunflower-yellow cardigan with two dark buns, a friend in pale blue, a lecture hall with a simple low lectern.
panels: At the front of class she grips a blank cue card at the lectern, eyes down and shoulders hunched as classmates wait.
After class in an empty room she practices facing her one friend, who gently models looking up and taking a slow breath.
At home she rehearses upright in front of a mirror, making eye contact with her reflection, card held low.
Back at the same school lectern, she speaks confidently with open palm and looks directly at the smiling classmates, who start applauding.
005.essay: 课堂上，老师应该只请举手的学生发言，还是也要给平时安静的学生发言的机会？

006.cast: A pair of relay runners on a school track. One is a short-haired teen boy in a lime running shirt, the other a brown-skinned teen girl with black ponytail and violet running shirt. A bright red relay baton.
panels: At school relay practice the girl reaches back too late, and the boy's red baton falls visibly between their outstretched hands onto the track.
Kneeling at the dropped baton, the partners pause to talk, one showing the other how to hold an open palm back.
At walking speed beside the track they carefully rehearse a handoff, the boy placing the bright red baton firmly into her open palm behind her.
At a school race, side-on close view of the same pair running fast in the same direction, completing a clean handoff in stride with cheering classmates in the background.
006.essay: 学校应该每天安排一段固定的户外运动时间吗？如果这样会减少一点上课时间，你还会支持吗？

007.cast: A young East Asian man with short black hair, a red checked overshirt, a shin cast and two crutches; a young Black woman in a teal hoodie is his classmate. School cafeteria.
panels: At the serving counter the boy balances on his two crutches and looks at his full lunch tray on the counter, both hands occupied with the crutches.
The classmate in teal notices and offers to carry the tray, indicating it with an open hand. The boy nods, relieved.
The classmate carries his full lunch tray with both hands; he follows alongside on crutches toward an empty cafeteria table.
Both now sit together, the crutches leaning on the chair. The boy splits a tangerine and offers her half in thanks as they eat.
007.essay: 学校该不该要求每个学生都参加志愿服务？

008.cast: A young East Asian art student with a single dark braid, forest-green shirt and peach apron. Her watercolor painting on cream paper is of a hillside and a small distant house; a small jar of black ink.
panels: She is adding pale green watercolor to her countryside painting at the school art table, a jar of dark ink beside her wrist.
Her elbow catches the jar. A large irregular black blot lands on the left side of the painted hillside. She stares in dismay.
She studies the blot, then uses a thin brush to extend dark branches UP from the blot and roots down, turning it into a tree trunk.

At the school display she presents the finished hillside painting: an elegant leafy tree has grown from the shape of the same black blot on the left, with the little house beyond. Her classmates admire it.
008.essay: 上美术课时，初学者应该先照着老师的画练习，还是一开始就试着画自己的想法？

009.cast: A school library is receiving donated books; coordinator is a curly-haired young woman with violet headband and blue shirt. Three different classmates join her. Use plain colored book covers without lettering.
panels: Alone at a classroom doorway she tries to lift an overfilled cardboard box of books, flexing her knees but barely budging it.
Seeing classmates nearby, she holds one book, gestures between the doorway and the library shelves, and invites them to help.
In a clear side view, the four classmates form a line from box to shelf, passing small stacks of books hand to hand.
The box is empty and the shelf is filled with the same colored books. The four sit nearby, happily choosing and reading the newly arrived books.
009.essay: 学校图书馆买书的钱有限时，应该优先购买纸质书还是电子书？

010.cast: An East Asian teenage boy with thick dark eyebrows, tousled hair and a cobalt-blue cooking apron; the school cooking teacher has short auburn hair and a white apron. Pancakes in a shallow pan.
panels: In cooking class the boy tilts a small pan and tries to flip his first round pancake with a broad spatula while the surface is still wet.
His pancake has folded into a torn, sticky heap. He looks at it with disappointment while the teacher comes over.
In a fresh pan the teacher points to small bubbles across a round pancake and shows how to slide the flat spatula under the cooked edge. The boy watches.
The boy slides his own beautifully round golden pancake from his pan onto a plate beside his earlier failed one. He and the teacher smile at the difference.
010.essay: 每个学生都应该在学校学会做几道简单的菜吗？

011.cast: Two college roommates in a small dormitory with two single beds: studious young woman with a plum-colored short haircut in a yellow sweater; tired roommate with long black hair in green pajamas. A bright adjustable desk lamp.
panels: At night the short-haired student reads at her desk with a bright desk lamp angled sideways. Light shines directly across her roommate's pillow.
The roommate in green sits up shading her eyes. The short-haired student looks up and follows her gesture toward the lamp.
Together they move the little desk to face the wall and tilt the adjustable lamp head DOWN over the open book, pointing away from the beds.
In a peaceful wide view the short-haired student works inside a small pool of lamplight facing the wall while the roommate sleeps comfortably in the darker bed.
011.essay: 上课记笔记时，你认为用电脑打字还是用手写更有助于理解和记忆？

012.cast: A young man with warm-brown skin, dark curly hair and a burnt-orange sweater presenting in school geography class. A desk projector, an unlettered blue-and-green globe and a cylindrical flashlight.
panels: At the front of a bright classroom he begins a geography presentation beside a projector showing a clear picture of Earth on the large screen.
The projector cuts out. The screen goes blank grey; he checks the unlit projector as the seated classmates wait.
He notices a small globe on the shelf and picks it up with a handheld flashlight, smiling as an idea strikes.
In a dimmed room he shines the flashlight from the SIDE onto the globe; one half glows while the far half stays dark. Seated students lean forward, interested in his demonstration of day and night.
012.essay: 写外语作业时，学生该不该用翻译软件检查自己写的句子？

013.cast: Two students in a campus changing room: taller short-haired girl in orange fencing warm-ups and shorter young man in a teal swim jacket. Their two compact black gym bags are identical and unmarked.
panels: After school sports practice the two students quickly pick up identical black zippered bags from the same bench and leave in different directions.
At the swimming pool the young man opens his bag expecting swimming goggles, but lifts out a rounded metal-mesh fencing mask, visibly surprised.
By the changing-room doorway the girl holds up bright blue swim goggles. Each recognizes their own gear and they laughingly exchange the two bags.
Back at the bench they tie different ribbons to their own bags, an orange ribbon for the fencer and a teal one for the swimmer. They hold up the now-distinct bag handles and smile.
013.essay: 你赞成让同学互相阅读作文、给对方提修改意见吗？

014.essay: 一家人即使每天都很忙，也应该尽量安排一顿饭坐下来一起吃吗？

015.essay: 孩子想养宠物时，父母要求孩子自己承担大部分照顾宠物的工作，这样做合适吗？

016.essay: 为朋友挑选生日礼物时，你觉得更应该买对方正需要的东西，还是准备一份出人意料的礼物？

017.essay: 和家人发生争执时，你觉得应该马上把问题谈清楚，还是等大家平静下来再谈？

018.essay: 外出游玩时，有人喜欢多拍些照片留作纪念，有人更愿意放下相机欣赏眼前的风景。你更赞同哪种做法？

019.essay: 家人分担家务时，应该让每个人花差不多的时间，还是按各人的长处来分工？

020.essay: 如果一项业余爱好能带来收入，你觉得应该试着靠它挣钱，还是把它留给自己的休息时间？

021.essay: 家里那些暂时用不上、但还完好的东西，你更愿意留着以后用，还是尽早送给需要的人？

022.essay: 周末有空时，你更喜欢提前把活动安排好，还是到了周末再决定做什么？

023.essay: 交朋友时，你更愿意认识和自己兴趣相近的人，还是愿意认识爱好很不一样的人？

024.essay: 想培养几种新的爱好时，你觉得应该同时试几样，还是先把一种学好再开始下一种？

025.essay: 在家里做饭时，你觉得应该尽量照着菜谱做，还是可以按自己的想法换食材、改做法？

026.essay: 成年子女离开父母独立生活以后，有必要每天都和父母联系吗？

027.essay: 超市打折时，有人会把常用的商品多买一些，也有人只买这次需要的东西。你更赞成哪种做法？

028.essay: 周末把市中心的一条街只留给行人，可以让人安心散步，也会让一些司机绕路。你支持这种安排吗？

029.essay: 社区有一笔活动经费，可以办一次很多人参加的大活动，也可以分几次办小活动。你觉得哪种安排更合适？

030.essay: 有居民希望小区门口的商店开到深夜，方便晚归的人买东西，也有居民担心晚上太吵。你赞成延长营业时间吗？

031.essay: 小区里有一块空地，有居民想建一个运动场，有居民想留一片安静的花园。如果只能选一个，你支持哪种方案？

032.essay: 城市改造一条老街时，有人想尽量保留老街原来的样子，有人想把路修宽，让居民出行更方便。你觉得应该先考虑什么？

033.essay: 买家具时，有人愿意选价格较低的二手家具，也有人觉得买新的更放心。你更愿意选哪一种？

034.essay: 挑选一家没去过的餐馆时，有人会先看网上的评价，也有人更相信熟人的推荐。你更看重哪一种意见？

035.essay: 有些社区准备了工具，居民需要时可以借用。对于一年只用几次的工具，你更愿意向社区借，还是自己买？

036.essay: 送礼时，有人愿意为漂亮的包装多花一点钱，也有人觉得普通包装就够了。你更赞成哪种做法？

037.essay: 网购时，有人愿意多付一点运费，让商品当天送到，也有人愿意多等几天，省下这笔钱。你更倾向于哪种做法？

038.essay: 城市里的公共博物馆应该免费开放，还是应该收取少量门票，用来改善展览和服务？你支持哪种做法？

039.essay: 去一个地方旅行时，有人想多走几个城市，也有人宁愿在一个地方多住几天。你更喜欢哪种安排？

040.essay: 有人认为，旅行时应当把钱多花在体验当地生活上。也有人更愿意花钱住得舒服。你更重视哪一方面？

041.essay: 有些公司允许员工自己决定几点上班，只要完成当天的工作。你支持这种安排吗？

042.essay: 选择第一份工作时，有人更重视工资，也有人更重视学习机会。你认为哪一点更重要？

043.essay: 在工作中，有人喜欢当面讨论问题，也有人觉得先写清楚再发消息更有效。你更赞成哪种做法？

044.essay: 有人认为，年轻人毕业后应该先到外地工作几年；也有人觉得留在熟悉的地方更合适。你怎么看？

045.essay: 参加户外活动时，有人喜欢独自出发，也有人更愿意和朋友结伴。你认为哪种方式更合适？

046.essay: 有人主张景区限制每天的游客人数，以减少对环境的影响。你赞成这样做吗？

047.essay: 有人认为游客应该尽量购买当地人制作的商品。也有人认为，只要东西合适，产地并不重要。你怎么看？

048.essay: 有些人宁愿在游客较少的季节出游，有些人愿意在最热闹的时候去同一个地方。你更赞成哪种选择？

049.essay: 有些人觉得，退休后继续学习一项新技能很有必要；也有人觉得，退休后应该多休息。你怎么看？

050.essay: 有些社区菜园把收获分给种菜的人，有些把收获送给附近需要帮助的家庭。如果只能选一种做法，你支持哪一种？
